OptionalObjectives: Prevent the enemy from reaching the northern gate
NarrativeIntroText: Ember Ridge is the last defensible position before the capital's outer wall. Ashen Covenant infantry are already scaling the southern slope. Hold the ridge for eight turns.
NarrativeOutroText: The Ashen tide breaks against the ridge. A Geomancer emerges from the rubble — trapped since the first assault. She owes you her life, and her stone-shaping skills are yours to command.
